chronicle.text: Thuhail tied fiber and fiber together with fiber and was left with something to carry things in: the first carrier.
Vosour drank from the sea and it did not quench their thirst.
Layizun came back for food left 7 weeks before, and it was still there.
Rosude gathered food that had grown where seeds had been dropped: the first harvest from seed left in the ground.
Thuhail scratched a mark <.\o> into the ground.
Habem tied a bundle they had tied and fiber together with fiber and was left with something that floats and carries someone across water: the first raft.
Habem went back to a thing they had made a third time, to see it happen again: the first deliberate testing.
Vozer tied a bundle they had tied and wood together with fiber and was left with something heavy on a handle: the first club.
Rosude buried seed on purpose, having seen it come back as food: the beginning of farming.
Thuhail struck flint with flint and stared at what happened.
Thuhail struck flint with flint and was left with a sharp edge: the first blade.
Thuhail tied a blade and wood together with fiber and was left with a sharp point on a long shaft: the first spear.
Thekek took in the orphan Sheidouneim, no relation, the first time a stranger raised another's child.
Tamour found that what Deideirou had told them was wrong, and trusted them less for it.
Thuhail struck flint where dry things lay, and they caught: the first fire made by people.
At (5, 6) the heap of things people had left grew big enough to keep out a fifth of the winter cold: the first dwelling. Goubei had put in the most.
A hungry year: 3 people starved after a poor growing season.
Vozer tied a carrier and a carrier together with fiber and was left with something warm to wear: the first wrap.
Tamour set food aside on purpose, having found it there when it was needed before: the beginning of keeping stores.
3 people now take the mark <^..> to go with a grave, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.
Layizun fed wood to a fire to keep it going: the first kept fire.
5 people now take the mark <\-.> to go with water, and have for two years. Nobody decided this; it grew from where the mark was made and seen.

Years 0-24: population 20 to 9, 11 births. Deaths mostly from starvation (8), illness (6), thirst (4). Average happiness 0.71. Recorded: 6 inventions, 13 firsts, 1 famines, 9 band changes, 5 new exchange partnerships, 2 new settlements.
Years 25-49: population 9 to 4, 0 births. Deaths mostly from old age (3), starvation (1), illness (1). Average happiness 0.71. Recorded: 1 new exchange partnerships, 3 new settlements.
Years 50-74: population 4 to 1, 0 births. Deaths mostly from old age (3). Average happiness 0.62. Recorded: 3 band changes.
